claims.value: StdMoE_1b14b_1T is a 1B-active / 14B-total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model (128 experts: 127 routed + 1 shared, k=8 active per token) pretrained on 1T tokens of the OLMoE pretraining mix.
claims.evidence: The architecture-matched standard MoE baseline released alongside EMO: Pretraining Mixture of Experts for Emergent Modularity

claims.value: The model was annealed for an additional 50B tokens with the standard MoE objective, differing from Emo_1b14b_1T only in the training objective.
claims.evidence: pretrained on 1T tokens of the OLMoE pretraining mix and annealed for an additional 50B tokens with the standard MoE objective
